item.title: Dudulog sa Korte Suprema… Erice, magpepetisyon laban sa ‘unprogrammed appropriations’ sa 2026 budget
item.description: Ayon kay Erice, hindi konstitusyonal ang pondong nasa unprogrammed appropriations alinsunod sa Section 22 ng Article 7 of the Philippine Constitution kung saan nakalagay na tukoy dapat ang pinagkukunan ng pondo para sa budget expenditures.

item.title: Pag-veto sa P92.5 bilyong unprogrammed funds, pinagpasalamat ni Sen. Tulfo
item.description: “Nagpapasalamat kami na pinakinggan ng Pangulo ang aming panawagan na limitahan ang paggamit ng unprogrammed appropriations at kanyang ni-veto ang P92.5 bilyong halaga ng mga proyektong isinama sa ilalim ng mekanismong ito,” ayon kay Tulfo.

item.title: Eala at Jović pasok na sa q'final ng 2026 ASB Classic
item.description: Pinay Tennis Player Alex Eala at ang ka-partner nito na si Iva Jović

item.title: P1.3T budget sa edukasyon, panalo ng kabataang Pilipino — Sen. Aquino
item.description: Ayon kay Aquino, “Panalo ang kabataang Pilipino sa P1.34 trilyong budget na ito para sa edukasyon. Mapopondohan na ang mahahalagang programang magpapalakas at magpapabuti sa sektor.”

item.title: 2026 national budget, pork barrel-free — ES Recto
item.description: Paliwanag niya, hindi naman aniya puwedeng mangialam ang legislator pagdating sa pag-execute ng budget at sinabing executive function na ito.

item.title: Pag-IBIG keeps low 3% rate as higher price ceilings lift quality of socialized homes
item.description: The updated ceilings, issued under the Implementing Rules and Regulations of the Department of Human Settlements and Urban Development (DHSUD) and the Department of Economy, Planning, and Development (DEPDev) Joint Memorandum Circular No. 2025-001, are intended to reflect current cost conditions and enable developers to deliver improved unit quality and safer housing standards.

item.title: PCSO turns over ₱900,000 Institutional Partnership grant to Life Home Mindanao, Inc.
item.description: The check was formally turned over by PCSO Cashier IV Alicia Saavedra to Life Home Mindanao, Inc. Executive Director Josephine De Vila. Also present during the activity were the organization’s officers, including Treasurer Cherie Mae Garaygay, Social Worker Jayde Cedeno, and Secretary Jazep Omega De Vila Fabroa.

item.title: PCSO turns over ₱500,000 IPP Grant to Lingap Pangarap ng mga Paslit Center
item.description: Lingap Pangarap ng Mga Paslit Center, Inc. was also formally welcomed as one of the newest partner institutions under the IPP, marking the start of a collaborative effort aimed at expanding the reach and impact of its social initiatives.

item.title: Venezuelan pres., nag-plead ng ‘not guilty’
item.description: Iginiit ni Maduro na siya ay inosente at disente, “I am innocent. I am not guilty. I am a decent man. I am still the president of my country,” aniya.

item.title: Biktima ng paputok, pumalo sa 720 — DOH
item.description: Ayon sa ahensya, mas mababa ito ng 14% kumpara sa 834 kaso noong nakaraang taon.
